gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-epunda-slab: Ethnocentric's wide-pushed letters and short ascenders over big bowls give it a fast, aggressive stance. And Epunda Slab, a classic serif with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, deserves a body size generous enough to show those openings.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-fauna-one: Dignified is the mood Fauna One carries, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders that read literary under a heading this fast. Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart and rushes ahead, and the classic serif below slows everything back down.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-glegoo: Ethnocentric spreads its aggressive, widely tracked letters across the top, with short ascenders sitting over big round bowls and no clogged curves anywhere. Glegoo's serif lowercase is tall with big counters and wide, unclosed mouths, so longer text goes down easily.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-hanuman: Letters pushed far apart, with short ascenders over big bowls, make Ethnocentric look like it is already moving at speed. Shrink it, though, and Hanuman's high-waisted serif lowercase would hold the page better.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-piazzolla: Ethnocentric arrives fast, wide and aggressive. Piazzolla answers with a classic serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals and whose e opens like a pried clasp, which makes the refined, authoritative body the pair's best card.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-pridi: Wide tracking pushes Ethnocentric's letters apart, and short ascenders sit over big bowls for a fast, aggressive look. It earns its keep big and brief, while Pridi's classic serif stands proud and almost capital-sized.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-scope-one: Refined is how Scope One feels, its counters spilling into the surrounding space beside stubby ascenders and a big x-height. Under Ethnocentric's fast, aggressive heading, a long passage in this serif would settle into a steady, traditional rhythm.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-slabo-13px: Bookish and dignified, Slabo 13px has large open counters in its tall a, e and s, and its rounded letters stay clearly open. Ethnocentric supplies the speed up top, so the serif below reads like a pause.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified, Suwannaphum holds a serif c as open as a bent paperclip and an x-height like a squared-off woodblock letter. And Ethnocentric does what it does best, pushing aggressive, widely tracked capitals forward, while the body handles sustained, editorial reading.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads clean and modern, its c ends pointing apart like pincers. Ethnocentric is the one that pulls attention, with fast, widely spaced letters and big bowls, while the sans keeps its stroke weight constant and the text quiet.
